features.label: Why FFmpeg is required
features.title: Why FFmpeg is required
features.description: FFmpeg powers probing, preview media, proxies, screen recording, and final renders. If it is missing, Preview shows a setup notice that opens the Video processing card.
features.requirement: On Windows/Linux x86_64, use the consented Install action for Cut's verified runtime. On macOS, install a compatible local build such as ffmpeg-full, then restart Cut; you can also set a binary path in Cut.

features.label: Run system doctor
features.title: Run system doctor
features.description: Use the doctor check when Cut cannot import, preview, transcribe, record, or render. It separates missing tools from project problems.
features.requirement: Open Settings and run the readiness check.

features.label: Set FFmpeg path
features.title: Set FFmpeg path
features.description: Point Cut at a specific FFmpeg binary when it is installed outside the normal system PATH.
features.requirement: Requires a local ffmpeg executable.

features.label: Install captions and STT
features.title: Install captions and STT
features.description: Captions need speech-to-text tooling in addition to FFmpeg. Install this when transcript actions show a setup message.
features.requirement: Requires Python plus a supported speech-to-text engine.

features.label: Install a CLI agent
features.title: Install a CLI agent
features.description: Install at least one supported CLI agent before using AI planning, prompt Generate, storyboard Generate, or review assistance.
features.requirement: Requires the selected CLI tool installed and signed in outside Cut.

features.label: Connect agent in Settings
features.title: Connect agent in Settings
features.description: After installing the CLI agent, connect it in Cut so Generate, chat, and review workflows can call it.
features.requirement: Requires a working CLI agent command.

features.label: Record workspace
features.title: Record workspace
features.description: Open Record to choose a display or, on Windows and macOS, an application window; confirm readiness, preview actual source pixels, select Raw MP4 or Polished clip in Edit, and start capture. On Linux, Start opens the system picker for a display. F9 can also start from Edit using the last valid setup after fresh source, device, permission, and project checks.
features.requirement: Requires a supported desktop capture backend and FFmpeg. Global F9 scope is reported only after OS callback proof.

features.label: Projects
features.title: Projects
features.description: Open, switch, create, or return to recent Cut projects. With a project open, Make a copy prepares a portable .cutproj with only the media it uses.
features.requirement: Project files use .cutproj directories. A portable copy needs an open project and the desktop app to choose its destination folder.

features.label: Library
features.title: Library
features.description: Open saved media, reusable assets, and library-backed material.
features.requirement: Requires media already saved to the library.

features.label: Settings and cache cleanup
features.title: Settings and editing cache
features.description: Configure tools, environment readiness, agents, paths, and editor preferences. Health & Recovery can estimate and rebuild missing Cut-owned proxies and filmstrips, then separately preview aged unreferenced cache before an explicit cancellable cleanup with before/removed/after reconciliation. The Motion card can verify a discovered runtime and connector descriptor read-only; managed lifecycle controls remain unavailable until the verified MOTION-DIST-01 distribution exists.
features.requirement: Some checks require FFmpeg or CLI tools installed locally. Rebuild and cleanup require an open project; cleanup also requires a complete ownership-ledger preview. Partial, changed, foreign, or symlinked inventories are refused. Motion discovery never installs, repairs, updates, removes, logs in, or executes a connector.
features.api: system.doctor, system.mcp_test, system.motion_status, project.cache_rebuild, project.cache_preview, project.cache_purge, jobs.cancel

features.label: Manual
features.title: Manual
features.description: Open Cut's bundled, indexed manual. Selecting an entry reveals its real editor surface without running the highlighted action.
features.requirement: Available in the desktop editor. The separately published online manual is a read-only reference.

features.label: Title
features.title: Title
features.description: Add title cards, lower thirds, or styled text overlays at the current playhead.
features.requirement: Requires an open project; title templates are optional.

features.label: Shape
features.title: Shape
features.description: Add basic shape overlays such as rectangles, circles, arrows, and callout blocks.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Mask / privacy
features.title: Mask / privacy
features.description: Draw a region for blur, pixelation, black-box privacy, or timed redaction from the playhead.
features.requirement: Requires a base-track video clip to target.

features.label: Music bed
features.title: Music bed
features.description: Add or manage a background music layer for the current edit.
features.requirement: Requires an audio file or available library music.

features.label: Audio mixer
features.title: Audio mixer
features.description: Open audio controls for track gain, pan, mute, solo, cleanup, and mix balance.
features.requirement: Requires audio tracks for most controls.

features.label: Repurpose into shorts
features.title: Repurpose into shorts
features.description: Create short-form variants from highlights, framing, captions, and export presets.
features.requirement: Works best with indexed media and transcript data.

features.label: Autopilot
features.title: Autopilot
features.description: Let an agent plan safe edits, apply reversible operations, and leave reviewable receipts.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Recipes
features.title: Recipes
features.description: Browse and run repeatable edit recipes for common production tasks: phone cleanup, social bundle, privacy mask, captions, YouTube export, and TikTok export. Timeline-changing recipes ask you to preview the exact plan before Run is enabled.
features.requirement: Recipe availability depends on the current project state.

features.label: Assemble AI
features.title: Assemble AI
features.description: Ask an agent to assemble a rough cut from prompts, selected media, or storyboard intent. When a b-roll folder is needed, choose it with the desktop folder dialog; Cut shows only its final folder name rather than an editable local path.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent and source media. Folder selection requires the desktop app.

features.label: Storyboard
features.title: Storyboard
features.description: Generate or inspect storyboard plans before inserting a sequence into the timeline.
features.requirement: Prompt/storyboard generation needs a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Comments
features.title: Comments
features.description: Open timeline notes, add or resolve feedback, or route a note into Agent Chat with its exact target.
features.requirement: Requires an open project for existing comments.

features.label: Faster exports (GPU)
features.title: Faster exports (hardware encoding)
features.description: The Faster ON / Faster OFF chip picks the encoder for renders and exports. On uses available video hardware for speed; off forces repeatable software encoding, which is what you want when two renders must match byte for byte.
features.requirement: Requires compatible video hardware and driver support for the ON state.

features.label: Title: add title
features.title: Add title
features.description: Add a text title at the current playhead.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Title: templates
features.title: Title templates
features.description: Choose a saved or built-in title style before inserting text.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Title: lower third
features.title: Lower third
features.description: Add a lower-third title treatment for names, speakers, or short labels.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Shape: rectangle
features.title: Rectangle shape
features.description: Insert a rectangle overlay for cards, callouts, masks, or emphasis.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Shape: circle
features.title: Circle shape
features.description: Insert a circular overlay or callout shape.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Shape: arrow
features.title: Arrow shape
features.description: Insert an arrow overlay to point at something in the frame.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Mask: blur face
features.title: Blur face
features.description: Choose Blur face, draw an oval over the face in the preview, and apply a soft privacy blur.
features.requirement: Requires a base-track video clip.

features.label: Mask: blur rectangle
features.title: Blur rectangle
features.description: Choose Blur rectangle for screen areas, labels, or objects that need a rectangular blur.
features.requirement: Requires a base-track video clip.

features.label: Mask: hide plate/text
features.title: Hide plate/text
features.description: Choose Hide plate/text to black out a license plate, address, password, or other visible private text.
features.requirement: Requires a base-track video clip.

features.label: Mask: timed privacy
features.title: Timed privacy from playhead
features.description: Switch Duration to From playhead and set the number of seconds when the private detail is visible.
features.requirement: Requires the playhead to be inside the selected clip.

features.label: Mask: custom shape
features.title: Custom mask shape
features.description: Use rectangle, ellipse, or polygon with blur, pixelate, or black box effects for a custom region.
features.requirement: Requires a drawn preview region.

features.label: Mask: apply mask
features.title: Apply mask
features.description: Apply the current mask and switch preview to the composed frame so the result is visible.
features.requirement: Requires a configured mask region.

features.label: Music: add music
features.title: Add music
features.description: Add a background music layer to the edit.
features.requirement: Requires a local audio file or available library music.

features.label: Music: duck voice
features.title: Duck voice
features.description: Lower the music bed under speech so narration remains clear.
features.requirement: Requires speech or narration audio plus a music layer.

features.label: Mixer: track gain
features.title: Track gain
features.description: Adjust gain on the selected track or clip.
features.requirement: Requires an audio track or linked audio.

features.label: Mixer: pan
features.title: Pan
features.description: Set stereo balance for an audio-bearing track without changing gain.
features.requirement: Requires an audio track or linked audio.

features.label: Mixer: mute or solo
features.title: Mute or solo
features.description: Mute a track or solo it while checking a mix.
features.requirement: Requires an audio track.

features.label: Mixer: EQ
features.title: EQ
features.description: Apply equalizer adjustments to improve voice, music, or source audio.
features.requirement: Requires an audio clip or track.

features.label: Mixer: cleanup voice
features.title: Cleanup voice
features.description: Run voice cleanup on speech material before final delivery.
features.requirement: Requires speech audio.

features.label: Repurpose: find highlights
features.title: Find highlights
features.description: Find likely short-form highlights from the current edit or source media.
features.requirement: Works best with indexed or transcribed media.

features.label: Repurpose: vertical crop
features.title: Vertical crop
features.description: Create vertical framing for shorts-style output.
features.requirement: Requires a visual clip.

features.label: Repurpose: shorts variants
features.title: Shorts variants
features.description: Generate multiple short-form variants from one source sequence.
features.requirement: Works best with a selected source range.

features.label: Autopilot: plan edit
features.title: Plan edit
features.description: Ask the configured agent to propose an edit plan.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Autopilot: apply safe ops
features.title: Apply safe ops
features.description: Apply reversible operations from an agent plan and leave them in review.
features.requirement: Requires a reviewed agent plan.

features.label: Recipes: browse
features.title: Browse recipes
features.description: Open available repeatable edit recipes.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Recipes: edit for clarity
features.title: Edit for clarity
features.description: Preview and run a conservative speech cleanup pass that removes retakes and fillers, then tightens pauses at the chosen intensity without forcing a delivery render.
features.requirement: Requires an open project with speech media and local speech-to-text readiness.

features.label: Recipes: describe
features.title: Describe recipe
features.description: Read what a recipe will do before running it.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Recipes: run
features.title: Run recipe
features.description: Run a repeatable edit recipe on the current project.
features.requirement: Requires a compatible recipe and project state.

features.label: Recipes: phone cleanup
features.title: Phone clip cleanup
features.description: Clean a phone or camera clip: transcribe, tighten pauses, remove fillers, clean voice audio, add captions, and render at online loudness.
features.requirement: Requires the asset on the timeline and FFmpeg plus caption tooling.

features.label: Recipes: social bundle
features.title: Social short bundle
features.description: Render the current short or timeline window as 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 social versions.
features.requirement: Requires a renderable timeline and FFmpeg.

features.label: Recipes: privacy mask
features.title: Blur or mask an area
features.description: Add a privacy mask to hide a face, label, password, or screen area on a clip.
features.requirement: Requires a base-track video clip id; use the Mask drawer for direct visual adjustment.

features.label: Recipes: add captions
features.title: Add captions
features.description: Transcribe an asset and add timeline captions without changing clip timing.
features.requirement: Requires an asset with speech and installed speech-to-text tooling.

features.label: Recipes: YouTube export
features.title: Export for YouTube
features.description: Render the current timeline with YouTube-ready geometry, bitrate, and container settings.
features.requirement: Requires a renderable timeline and FFmpeg.

features.label: Recipes: TikTok export
features.title: Export for TikTok
features.description: Render the current timeline with TikTok-ready vertical geometry, bitrate, and container settings.
features.requirement: Requires a renderable timeline and FFmpeg.

features.label: Assemble: prompt
features.title: Assemble prompt
features.description: Describe the rough cut you want the agent to assemble.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Assemble: source clips
features.title: Source clips
features.description: Choose source clips for an assembled draft.
features.requirement: Requires imported media.

features.label: Assemble: build draft
features.title: Build draft
features.description: Build a rough timeline draft from the selected sources and prompt.
features.requirement: Requires source clips and a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Storyboard: generate plan
features.title: Generate storyboard plan
features.description: Generate a storyboard plan before inserting clips or generated assets.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Storyboard: review shots
features.title: Review shots
features.description: Inspect planned shots before committing them to the timeline.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Storyboard: preview sequence
features.title: Preview sequence
features.description: Preview the storyboard sequence before insertion.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Storyboard: insert
features.title: Insert storyboard
features.description: Insert the storyboard plan into the timeline.
features.requirement: Requires a generated storyboard plan.

features.label: Comments: add comment
features.title: Add comment
features.description: Add a review note to the current project or selected edit.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Comments: make changes
features.title: Make changes
features.description: Route this comment and its exact timeline target to Agent Chat. The target is checked again before Chat runs.
features.requirement: Requires an existing comment, an open project, and a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Comments: resolve
features.title: Resolve comment
features.description: Mark a review comment as resolved after the issue is handled.
features.requirement: Requires an existing comment.

features.label: Render
features.title: Render
features.description: Render the current project or selected range using the active project settings.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg and a valid output folder.

features.label: Export menu
features.title: Export menu
features.description: Choose delivery targets, output presets, and platform-oriented export paths.
features.requirement: Requires a renderable timeline.

features.label: Projects: open project
features.title: Open project
features.description: Open an existing .cutproj project directory.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Projects: create project
features.title: Create project
features.description: Create a new Cut project.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Projects: take a copy with you
features.title: Take a copy with you
features.description: Open Make a copy, choose a destination folder, and preview the exact used-media count, dedupe, cache exclusion, and current collision state before confirming. When the current revision is a grouped bulk relink, Cut carries that durable receipt into the package plan and refuses missing, stale, or mismatched evidence. The copy contains only used media; the current project and original files remain unchanged.
features.requirement: Requires an open project and the desktop app for the destination-folder picker. Switching project or revision clears older relink/package results before another action can run.

features.label: Library: saved assets
features.title: Saved assets
features.description: Browse saved assets available for reuse.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Library: add to project
features.title: Add to project
features.description: Add a saved library asset into the current project.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Render: preview render
features.title: Draft-quality check pass
features.description: Set the quality preset to draft for a fast look at the whole timeline before committing to a delivery render.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg.

features.label: Render: full file
features.title: Render the timeline
features.description: Render the whole timeline using the quality preset, delivery aspect and loudness target chosen in this panel. The deterministic checks run themselves and leave a receipt.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg and an output folder.

features.label: Render: selected range
features.title: Render selected range
features.description: Mark a range on the timeline ruler, then use Render selection under the Preview monitor to render only that window.
features.requirement: Requires a marked range on the ruler.

features.label: Export: final video
features.title: Final video
features.description: Export the project as a final video file.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg.

features.label: Export: platform bundle
features.title: Publish presets
features.description: Publish straight to a platform's geometry and bitrate: YouTube 16:9, TikTok/Shorts 9:16, Instagram Reels 9:16, or X 16:9. A multi-platform pack with captions and a thumbnail comes from the Social short bundle recipe instead.
features.requirement: Requires a renderable timeline and FFmpeg.

features.label: Export: project archive
features.title: Keeping a copy of a project
features.description: There is no project-archive export in this release. A project is an ordinary .cutproj folder holding the operation log and cached artifacts, so copying or zipping that folder keeps everything; use Interchange (OTIO, EDL, XML) to hand the edit to another tool.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Export: preflight warnings
features.title: Preflight warnings
features.description: Cut checks for likely export problems before starting a video render. High-risk issues block export; advisory warnings can continue.
features.requirement: Requires a renderable timeline.

features.label: Preflight: black ending
features.title: Black ending
features.description: The timeline continues after the last video clip, so the export would end on black frames.
features.requirement: Trim the tail, shorten audio, or add picture before exporting.

features.label: Preflight: dead frames
features.title: Black or frozen footage
features.description: A clip contains black or frozen frames in the edited range.
features.requirement: Trim around the dead frames or replace the shot.

features.label: Preflight: long holds
features.title: Long holds
features.description: The base story has very few cuts over a long timeline.
features.requirement: Add cuts, motion, or shorten holds if the static pacing is not intentional.

features.label: Preflight: silent export
features.title: Silent export
features.description: The timeline appears to export without audible audio.
features.requirement: Add or unmute audio, or continue if the video is intentionally silent.

features.label: Preflight: tiny clips
features.title: Tiny clips
features.description: One or more clips are shorter than a video frame and may not visibly render.
features.requirement: Delete the stray clip or extend it.

features.label: Preflight: black border
features.title: Black border
features.description: Source media appears letterboxed or pillarboxed.
features.requirement: Crop to visible content if you do not want black bands in the export.

features.label: Transcript tab
features.title: Transcript tab
features.description: Browse a timeline-linked phrase and chapter list with exact start-end ranges. Clicking a range seeks the matching timeline occurrence; reused media asks you to choose the occurrence, and unavailable media explains why it cannot open.
features.requirement: Requires speech-to-text tooling for generated transcripts. Offline transcripts remain readable even when their media occurrence cannot be opened.

features.label: Assets tab
features.title: Assets tab
features.description: Use Assets to confirm imported media, read per-clip readiness, filter by type or action needed, and add clips to the base timeline at the playhead.
features.requirement: Requires a project and at least one imported media file.

features.label: Asset filters
features.title: Asset filters
features.description: Filter imported media by kind, unused state, 4K, missing files, recent changes, or clips that need action.
features.requirement: Requires imported media.

features.label: Assets: needs action
features.title: Needs action filter
features.description: Show only media that needs a user decision, such as relinking a missing file or handling a large source-only clip.
features.requirement: Requires imported media. The filter is view-only and does not change project media.

features.label: Media Health and recover missing media
features.title: Media Health and recover missing media
features.description: Shows whether source files are missing, which large clips are using source playback, how many proxies are ready, and how many items need action. When assets are offline, Recover missing media reviews a chosen folder and offers only uniquely exact full-file hash matches before it rechecks accepted selections as one grouped metadata operation. A unique strong metadata resemblance is labeled “Possible replacement — review individually” and sends you to normal one-file Relink; it is never selected for grouped apply.
features.requirement: Requires imported media. Recover missing media appears only for offline assets; ambiguous, sampled, changed, symlinked, or merely similar files are not selectable. The review hint needs matching basename, kind, byte size, and duration or still dimensions; available format/codec/geometry conflicts refuse it.
features.api: media.check, media.relink, media.relink_preview, media.relink_apply, proxy preference

features.label: Proxy imports
features.title: Proxy imports
features.description: Turn proxy generation on for future imports when editing 4K, phone, or camera files that preview roughly from source media.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg and newly imported video files.

features.label: Import media
features.title: Import media
features.description: Bring video, audio, and image files into the current project. The first import can become the starting timeline.
features.requirement: Requires readable local media and FFmpeg for probe/proxy work.

features.label: Add at playhead
features.title: Add at playhead
features.description: Insert an asset at the current playhead on the base story timeline. A probed video with audio is placed as one aligned picture-and-sound action, so it cannot leave only one half behind.
features.requirement: Requires an imported asset and an open project. Muxed video needs both an admitted video and audio destination.

features.label: Generate tab
features.title: Generate tab
features.description: Create prompt plans, storyboard material, generated inserts, and reusable generated assets.
features.requirement: Prompt and storyboard planning need a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Generate: history and compare
features.title: Generated history and compare
features.description: Review integrity-checked project generation history, compare takes, choose one, then insert it or replace the selected clip without regenerating.
features.requirement: Requires at least one completed generated image or video in the open project.

features.label: Generate: references and variations
features.title: References and variations
features.description: Attach up to four registered project image or video assets as generation references and label the requested variation. Choose Codex images, Grok Imagine images/video, or Antigravity (`agy`) images; retry reuses saved provenance and never exposes arbitrary source paths.
features.requirement: Provider-backed generation requires the selected local generation CLI and may spend provider quota only after confirmation. Antigravity uses its native sandboxed non-interactive contract and is image-only.

features.label: Motion: Edit in Motion
features.title: Edit in Motion
features.description: Open the selected linked Motion package in ShellX Motion without exposing the package or return-request paths. ShellX Motion publishes a new immutable ready revision only after its render is verified.
features.requirement: Requires a selected Motion-linked clip and an installed or configured ShellX Motion editor.

features.label: Motion: refresh linked render
features.title: Refresh linked Motion render
features.description: Adopt the newest verified Canvas return for the same package, motion identity, and authored source revision, replacing pixels in the existing Cut clip without changing its editorial identity.
features.requirement: Run Edit in Motion and complete a verified Canvas render first. A mismatch or failed render leaves the last good Cut clip untouched.

features.label: Motion: track and stabilize
features.title: Track and stabilize linked footage
features.description: Choose manifest-declared footage and a visual target, analyze a point or planar region, apply ordinary Motion transform keyframes, verify the attachment, or detach back to the exact prior keyframes.
features.requirement: Requires a Motion-linked package with footage and a target visual layer. Refresh remains explicit after applying or detaching.

features.label: Find tab
features.title: Find tab
features.description: Keep search available at all times in the sidebar. Use it for reusable media, local folders, source-backed stock, cited project moments, and the cross-sequence index. A local-folder search uses the desktop folder picker and displays only the chosen folder name; there is no typed filesystem-path field.
features.requirement: Find media searches external or local sources; Find moment needs an open project with imported media. Local-folder selection requires the desktop app.
features.api: assets.providers, assets.search, assets.fetch, media.intelligence_status, media.intelligence_search, ui.open

features.label: Find: media
features.title: Find media
features.description: Choose a source from the matching Cut server, search its supported kinds, review license and credit, then import into the open project. Built-in stickers work offline and can be browsed without a query; network sources are contacted when you search or import a result.
features.requirement: Requires an open project.

features.label: Find: moment
features.title: Find moment
features.description: Search cited spoken words, visuals, scenes, beats, markers, and media metadata; preview the registered source, jump to a real current-sequence use, or select citations to discuss with Agent Chat.
features.requirement: Requires imported media. Prepare search derives citations only from analysis already stored in the project; it does not silently run missing analysis.

features.label: Find: Sequence Index
features.title: Sequence Index
features.description: Search clips and markers across every project sequence, filter by result kind, sequence, or track, then switch sequences and seek the exact result time.
features.requirement: Requires an open project; results remain path-light and project-scoped.

features.label: Video preview
features.title: Video preview
features.description: Preview the current frame, selected edit, and rendered composition while you work.
features.requirement: Requires imported media for real playback.

features.label: Preview setup notice
features.title: Preview setup notice
features.description: When FFmpeg is missing, Preview shows a clear setup notice with an Install action that opens the Video processing card.
features.requirement: Requires the system doctor to confirm FFmpeg is missing.

features.label: Play controls
features.title: Play controls
features.description: Jump to start or end, shuttle backward or forward, and play or pause the timeline.
features.requirement: Requires an open timeline.
features.api: ui.playhead (play/pause is a preview transport, not a verb)

features.label: Frame button
features.title: Frame button
features.description: Capture or save the current preview frame for review or reuse.
features.requirement: Requires a visible preview frame.

features.label: Render selection
features.title: Render selection
features.description: Render only the selected range when a timeline range is active.
features.requirement: Requires an export range on the ruler.

features.label: Audio monitor
features.title: Audio monitor
features.description: Toggle and monitor preview audio while checking cuts, sync, and narration.
features.requirement: Requires audio in the timeline for level movement.

features.label: Composed toggle
features.title: Composed toggle
features.description: Switch composed preview on or off when checking generated frames, overlays, or render previews.
features.requirement: Depends on the active render or preview mode.

features.label: Compare edits
features.title: Compare edits
features.description: Pause and place the exact composed frame before the latest timeline edit beside the current durable frame. Before is on the left and Current is on the right; closing it never changes the timeline.
features.requirement: Requires a saved timeline edit with an earlier compatible state and visible media at the current playhead. Later project metadata stays part of Current but does not become a deceptive identical Before. If Cut cannot prove that pair, Compare explains why instead of guessing.

features.label: Guides
features.title: Guides
features.description: Cycle visual guides for safe areas, thirds, or both when framing titles and overlays.
features.requirement: No setup required.

features.label: Full-screen preview
features.title: Full-screen preview
features.description: Expand the monitor when checking focus, titles, caption placement, or visual defects.
features.requirement: No setup required.

features.label: Timecode
features.title: Timecode
features.description: Read or jump the current playhead time while trimming and reviewing edits.
features.requirement: Requires an open timeline.

features.label: Razor
features.title: Razor
features.description: Split a clip at the playhead so each side can be moved, trimmed, graded, or deleted independently.
features.requirement: Requires a clip under the playhead.

features.label: Trim
features.title: Trim
features.description: Adjust clip in and out points while keeping the edit on the timeline.
features.requirement: Requires a selected clip or trim handle.

features.label: Snap
features.title: Snap
features.description: Toggle magnetic alignment to clip edges, markers, and playhead positions.
features.requirement: No setup required.

features.label: Ripple delete
features.title: Ripple delete
features.description: Delete a selection and close the gap so following clips move left.
features.requirement: Requires a selected clip or range.

features.label: Lift delete
features.title: Lift delete
features.description: Delete a selection while leaving a gap in its original time span.
features.requirement: Requires a selected clip or range.

features.label: Speed controls
features.title: Speed controls
features.description: Retiming controls change clip playback speed while preserving the edit span rules.
features.requirement: Requires a selected clip.

features.label: Sync by audio
features.title: Sync by audio
features.description: Align clips using their audio waveforms when matching camera or recorder sources.
features.requirement: Requires clips with usable audio.

features.label: Auto multicam
features.title: Auto multicam
features.description: Build a multicam-style alignment from multiple sources when their audio can be matched.
features.requirement: Requires multiple compatible clips.

features.label: Cut to beat
features.title: Cut to beat
features.description: Place cuts or timing choices against detected beats in the audio.
features.requirement: Requires analyzed audio.

features.label: Cleanup tools
features.title: Cleanup tools
features.description: Run cleanup and scene-detection actions directly beside editing tools instead of opening a top-bar menu.
features.requirement: Requires an open project. Scene actions need at least one imported video asset.

features.label: Trim dead air
features.title: Trim dead air
features.description: Trim silence from the beginning and end of the current timeline while keeping the operation reversible.
features.requirement: Requires an open timeline with audio analysis available.

features.label: Split scenes
features.title: Split scenes
features.description: Split the first imported video asset at detected scene cuts so each scene can be moved, trimmed, or deleted.
features.requirement: Requires an imported video asset with scene detection data.

features.label: Mark scenes
features.title: Mark scenes
features.description: Add timeline markers at detected scene cuts without changing clip timing.
features.requirement: Requires an imported video asset with scene detection data.

features.label: Grade, Layer, Matte
features.title: Grade, Layer, Matte
features.description: Open visual editing groups for color, compositing, layer behavior, and matte work.
features.requirement: Requires a selected visual clip.

features.label: Ask agent
features.title: Ask agent
features.description: Open Agent Chat with the selected range, clips, or playhead attached as an immutable target. Write and send the normal Chat request to continue.
features.requirement: Requires an open project and a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Timeline: track controls
features.title: Track controls
features.description: Use lane headers for show/hide, lock, layer order, mute, solo, listen, gain, and pan without opening the mixer first.
features.requirement: Requires at least one timeline track; controls vary by track kind.
features.api: edit.track_visible, edit.track_lock, edit.reorder_track, edit.mute, edit.solo, edit.gain, edit.pan, export.audio

features.label: Track: show or hide
features.title: Show or hide a track
features.description: Hide a video or caption lane from preview and export without deleting its clips. Use mute for audio tracks.
features.requirement: Requires a video or caption track.

features.label: Track: lock edits
features.title: Lock track edits
features.description: Lock a lane when it should stay in place. Drag/drop, trim, move, split targets, delete, and context-menu edits skip locked tracks until you unlock them.
features.requirement: Works on any timeline track.

features.label: Track: layer order
features.title: Layer order
features.description: Send an overlay video track backward or bring it forward in the visual stack.
features.requirement: Requires more than one video track.

features.label: Track: mute
features.title: Mute track
features.description: Silence an audio-bearing track without changing its gain value.
features.requirement: Requires an audio-bearing track.

features.label: Track: solo
features.title: Solo track
features.description: Hear only soloed tracks while checking a mix. Explicit mute still wins.
features.requirement: Requires an audio-bearing track.

features.label: Track: listen
features.title: Listen to one track
features.description: Render or check the selected audio track by itself when diagnosing a mix.
features.requirement: Requires an audio track.

features.label: Track: gain
features.title: Track gain
features.description: Set a compact per-track gain value directly from the lane header.
features.requirement: Requires an audio-bearing track.

features.label: Track: pan
features.title: Track pan
features.description: Set common pan positions from the lane header: left, center, right, or half-left/half-right.
features.requirement: Requires an audio-bearing track.

features.label: Timeline voiceover
features.title: Timeline voiceover
features.description: Record into the selected audio track after a visible three-second count-in. Start at the playhead or use the current In-Out range; Stop places one sealed take as one Undoable edit, while Cancel adds nothing.
features.requirement: Requires an unlocked audio track, an admitted native microphone, and a supported host. Direct monitoring stays off.

features.label: Base track and overlays
features.title: Base track and overlays
features.description: Normal Insert and normal drops build the base story timeline and ripple later clips. A probed video with audio is placed in one aligned picture-and-sound action; both destinations are checked or created together. Extra video tracks are overlays: use Alt-drag, a new overlay lane, or an existing overlay lane when the clip should appear on top.
features.requirement: Requires an open project; overlay placement requires an overlay lane or Alt-drag. Muxed video needs both an admitted video and audio destination.

features.label: Save to Assets and GIF
features.title: Save to Assets and GIF
features.description: Save selected output back into project assets or create a GIF from the current selection.
features.requirement: Requires a selected range or renderable clip.

features.label: Using context menus
features.title: Using context menus
features.where: Assets, Library, Projects, Preview, and Timeline
features.description: Right-click the exact item you want to work on. Cut keeps that target through the menu action instead of applying it to a similarly named or merely selected item. Commands that need an open project, compatible media, an unlocked track, or copied clip stay visible but explain why they are unavailable.
features.requirement: For a focused Library item or folder, timeline clip, marker, or track header, press the Context Menu key or Shift+F10. Once open, use Arrow keys, Home, or End to move between enabled commands; Escape or an outside click closes the menu.
features.api: UI menu; its enabled actions dispatch the corresponding Cut operation

features.label: Assets: item menu
features.title: Asset item menu
features.description: Right-click an asset card or use its More actions button. Video, audio, and still-image assets can open in Source Monitor; audio-bearing sources show a seekable waveform with amber In/Out marks and a white current-position line, while All uses remains UI-only navigation over exact per-asset Sequence Index rows. A still shows an image preview with a bounded duration and an unlocked video target or Off; it has no pretend transport, source marks, range insert, or audio destination. Source Monitor can reveal that registered asset in Project Assets or Library, or ask the installed desktop shell to reveal its local source file; browser and unavailable-source cases explain why they refuse. An online asset can be added at the playhead; an offline asset gets Relink source. Remove from project is disabled while the asset still has timeline clips, and does not delete the original source file.
features.requirement: Requires an imported asset. Waveform seeking requires audio. The exact actions vary by media kind, offline state, and whether Cut is already updating that asset.

features.label: Library: item and folder menus
features.title: Library item and folder menus
features.description: A Library item menu can add or insert its exact item into the open project, toggle favorite, edit tags, move it to a folder, relink a missing source, make a portable copy, or remove it from the Library. A folder menu is intentionally shorter: rename or delete the folder.
features.requirement: Add and Insert require an open project and an available source. Focus a Library item or folder and use the Context Menu key or Shift+F10 when you do not want to right-click.
features.api: UI menu; exact Library item or folder target

features.label: Projects: recent-project menu
features.title: Recent project menu
features.description: Use the menu on a recent-project row to reopen that exact project, forget only its recent-list entry, or delete that project after confirmation. Forget leaves files on disk; deleting leaves original media files untouched.
features.requirement: The current project cannot be reopened or deleted here. A missing project must be restored or forgotten first.

features.label: Preview: More actions
features.title: Preview menu
features.description: Right-click the Preview monitor or choose More Preview actions. When there is an unambiguous base clip under the playhead, open that source in Source Monitor or seek to its start; with an open project, add a marker at the exact preview time.
features.requirement: Open base source and Seek stay disabled over a black frame, gap, or composited view with no unambiguous base video.
features.api: edit.add_marker; exact base clip and preview time

features.label: Timeline: clip menu
features.title: Timeline clip menu
features.description: Right-click inside a timeline clip for target-specific edits. Footage exposes Match Frame, which opens Source Monitor on the exact normal/reverse/freeze source frame under the playhead; speed ramps and unavailable sources remain disabled instead of guessed. Its Reveal in Project / Library entries focus the exact registered asset in an existing surface. Reveal Source File is desktop-only and re-resolves that asset in the native shell; browser, missing, offline, and non-file cases tell you why they refuse. Media clips also expose split, trim, copy/cut/paste attributes, source replacement or fitting, transitions and fades, Audio, Speed & time, picture controls, and the two remove choices. Caption clips keep only caption edit, seek, and remove; generated titles and shapes keep Inspector edit, Transform, split, and remove so rendered overlays cannot be treated as ordinary footage.
features.requirement: Focus a clip and press the Context Menu key or Shift+F10 for the keyboard route. Some entries depend on clip kind, a valid seam or click point, selected clips, an adjacent gap, imported compatible media, or timeline audio.
features.api: UI-only source navigation plus edit operations retain the exact clip target

features.label: Timeline: empty lane and gap menu
features.title: Timeline empty-lane and gap menu
features.description: Right-click an empty lane to seek, paste the copied clip on its compatible unlocked track, add a marker, set the export in or out point, or add a video or audio track. Right-click a visible gap to seek its start, paste at the gap, select the gap as the export range, or fit a compatible copied clip to fill it.
features.requirement: Empty-lane editing needs an open project. Paste requires a copied compatible clip and an unlocked target track; fit also requires the source clip to remain on the timeline and to meet the shown speed range.

features.label: Timeline: track menu
features.title: Timeline track menu
features.description: Right-click a video track header to Match Frame the clip under the playhead in Source Monitor; normal, reverse, and freeze map exactly, while ramps and unavailable sources stay disabled. At a crossfade or other overlap, select one clip directly before Match Frame can identify its exact source. Track headers also lock or unlock; video and caption tracks can show or hide; audio tracks can mute or solo. Non-base tracks can be removed after confirmation. A right-clicked clip on a locked track instead offers inspection and unlock, never an edit.
features.requirement: Focus a track header and press the Context Menu key or Shift+F10 for the keyboard route. Base video and audio tracks cannot be removed.
features.api: UI-only source navigation; edit.track_lock, edit.track_visible, edit.mute, edit.solo; exact track target

features.label: Timeline: marker menu
features.title: Timeline marker menu
features.description: Right-click a plain timeline marker to rename it, add a note, choose its color, seek to its time, or delete it. Enter commits a rename; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves a note; Escape leaves the menu without saving.
features.requirement: Focus a plain marker and press the Context Menu key or Shift+F10 for the keyboard route. Non-editable marker classes do not open this menu.
features.api: edit.update_marker, edit.remove_marker, edit.seek_marker; exact marker target

features.label: Properties tab
features.title: Properties tab
features.description: Show selected clip details, engagement scoring, fades, clip actions, and transform controls.
features.requirement: Requires a selected clip for clip-specific controls.

features.label: Color tab
features.title: Color tab
features.description: Adjust grade and color controls for the selected visual clip. Tag its input as Rec.709, Rec.2020, sRGB, or scene-linear so Cut can convert it into the project's working and output spaces before grade/effects. Browse for a LUT with the native desktop file dialog; Cut shows the selected filename rather than exposing an editable absolute path.
features.requirement: Requires a selected visual clip. LUT browsing requires the desktop app. The four explicit tags are lightweight color management, not camera Log interpretation or an end-to-end HDR mastering or delivery workflow.

features.label: Audio tab
features.title: Audio tab
features.description: Select an audio clip to shape Clip volume over its waveform: Add point at playhead, Ctrl/Cmd-click the curve, or drag a named point. Use Inspector for exact time, level, interpolation, or Clear automation; static Gain resumes unchanged after Clear.
features.requirement: Requires a selected audio clip on an unlocked track with a current project revision; speed-ramped clips explain why automation is unavailable.

features.label: Chat tab
features.title: Chat tab
features.description: Use the connected agent to discuss the current project, a selected edit, or an attached timeline target.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent and an open project.

features.label: Chat: attach project assets
features.title: Attach project assets
features.description: Attach up to eight registered project assets to a turn. Cut validates the IDs, shows them on the request, and never accepts an arbitrary source path through Chat.
features.requirement: Requires an open project with imported assets and a configured CLI agent.

features.label: Chat: applied change
features.title: Applied Chat change
features.description: Chat applies a validated result directly. The turn keeps its request, baseline, tip, and diff; use Step back only while the guarded whole-turn revert is safe, or Ask replacement to re-resolve the target before a new request.
features.requirement: Requires an agent turn that applied at least one operation. Concurrent later changes can make Step back unavailable.

features.label: Chat: clear timeline target
features.title: Clear Chat target
features.description: Remove the attached timeline target before sending so the next request uses the context you choose.
features.requirement: Requires an attached timeline target and an open project.

features.label: Tools overlay
features.title: Tools overlay
features.description: Open selected-clip tools without permanently narrowing the timeline. The overlay closes with the close button, Escape, or an outside click.
features.requirement: No setup required.

features.label: Pin tools
features.title: Pin tools
features.description: Pin the selected-clip tools beside the editor when you want a persistent inspector; unpin to return to the full-width timeline.
features.requirement: Open the Tools overlay first.

features.label: Fades
features.title: Fades
features.description: Set fade-in and fade-out values for the selected clip.
features.requirement: Requires a selected clip.

features.label: Transform
features.title: Transform
features.description: Adjust position, scale, crop, and related visual transform settings.
features.requirement: Requires a selected visual clip.

features.label: Review Ops
features.title: Review Ops
features.description: Read every applied operation so edits remain auditable and reversible.
features.requirement: Requires project operations in the current session or file.

features.label: Receipts, QC, Scopes, Diff
features.title: Receipts, QC, Scopes, Diff
features.description: Switch review tabs to inspect receipts, quality checks, video scopes, and project diffs before delivery.
features.requirement: Some tabs depend on completed review, render, or scope-check jobs.

features.label: Video scopes
features.title: Video scopes
features.description: Run an objective frame check for luma, saturation, white balance, broadcast range, and clipping. Turn on images when you want vectorscope, waveform, or histogram evidence. Agents and tests can open this exact tab with ui.open {panel:"scopes"}.
features.requirement: Requires an open project with a renderable frame and FFmpeg.

features.label: Studio preview
features.title: Record workspace
features.description: Screen and sound, the real selected-source preview, recording settings, and a persistent Start/Stop transport share the Record workspace. Native preview shows source pixels before Start; during capture the exact active capture supplies live frames, or Record shows an unavailable or stale state while keeping Stop usable. A selected whole display includes Cut when Cut is visible. Refresh sources after a source or device change, and use optional video-only rehearsal to check framing. Recording settings contain Camera, Background, Video timer, Capture timing, and Video quality. Advanced frame rate accepts whole-number custom 1–240 FPS only after Apply or Enter; an invalid draft leaves the prior rate active. Cut remembers one selected microphone as an app-local preference. Pre-Start controls bind to the current preview generation and opaque server-owner lease; the lease changes when Cut server restarts. A failed Stop is classified by status for its capture ID before Retry Stop is offered.
features.requirement: Requires current native capture admission and a writable default export folder. Preview, camera, meters, and Pause depend on actual OS and backend capability.
features.api: screen_record.preview_capability, screen_record.preview_start, screen_record.preview_frame, screen_record.live_frame, screen_record.rehearsal_start, screen_record.start, screen_record.status, screen_record.stop

features.label: Recording scenes
features.title: Camera layout
features.description: Choose Camera on or off, then choose one of four corners, Circle or Rounded rectangle, size, and background. Manual placement survives internal scene changes until Reset camera layout.
features.requirement: Camera requires an admitted device and Polished mode; unavailable controls show the reason.

features.label: Recording timer
features.title: On-video timer
features.description: Choose Off, Count up, or Count down. Apply a custom countdown duration from 00:00:01 to 23:59:59; 1, 5, and 10 minutes are shortcuts. During capture, timer Pause, Resume, Reset, Restart, and End affect the overlay only. Reaching zero does not stop recording.
features.requirement: Requires a saved timer configuration and native scene support. Capture Pause and capture length are separate controls.

features.label: Pause and resume
features.title: Pause and resume
features.description: On a supported macOS build, explicitly enable Pause & resume before Start. During the live recording the same button becomes Pause or Resume, and Cut changes its state only after the native owner durably acknowledges the transition.
features.requirement: Requires one exact Display at a whole-number frame rate. Scenes, Camera, keystrokes, Window capture, and Quality remain unavailable for that take; other platforms explain that Pause is unavailable.

features.label: Camera take
features.title: Camera take
features.description: Turn Camera on in Polished mode and choose one current device. Cut records it as a separate editable take instead of baking it into the screen source.
features.requirement: In Polished mode, Camera is available on Windows/macOS when Doctor lists a current device. No connected camera or unavailable discovery leaves Camera disabled while screen recording stays available. Start still requires the OS to admit the selected camera and deliver a real first frame. Linux currently shows Camera unavailable. Raw mode keeps Camera off.

features.label: Show or hide camera
features.title: Show or hide camera
features.description: The Studio preview shows whether the separate camera take will appear in the polished composition. Visibility changes remain editable, timed Studio metadata.
features.requirement: Requires Camera to be enabled for this Polished recording.

features.label: Camera position
features.title: Camera position
features.description: Choose top left, top right, bottom right, or bottom left. The selected corner stays visible and survives internal scene changes until Reset camera layout.
features.requirement: Requires an admitted Camera in Polished mode.
features.api: screen_record.studio_event {source:"camera", kind:"transform", x, y}; camera reset

features.label: Camera size
features.title: Camera size
features.description: Adjust the camera overlay size while keeping the captured camera video as its own editable source.
features.requirement: Requires Camera to be enabled.

features.label: Camera shape
features.title: Camera shape
features.description: Choose Circle or Rounded rectangle for the camera overlay. Shape is composition metadata and does not crop the original camera take destructively.
features.requirement: Requires Camera to be enabled.

features.label: Background
features.title: Background
features.description: Choose the recording background style for polished screen-demo output while raw streams remain untouched.
features.requirement: Works with Polished recording output.

features.label: Raw streams
features.title: Raw streams
features.description: After a capture, Cut reports the raw screen, optional camera, microphone, system audio, and Studio metadata so you can diagnose or reuse exactly what was finalized. The camera remains a separate editable take. On Windows 10 build 20348 or newer, system audio uses endpoint-independent process loopback; if security software blocks it, screen, camera, and microphone capture can still report their own terminal outcomes.
features.requirement: Requires a completed capture. A new Windows build may need one audio-capture approval from security software.

features.label: Recording hotkeys
features.title: Recording hotkeys
features.description: F9 is one Start/Stop action across Cut, including Edit and another focused app when the OS global route has been observed. Start uses the open project when one exists; otherwise Cut creates a new recording project before capture. It revalidates the last valid setup, source, devices, and permissions; invalid setup opens Record with a reason and starts no capture. F12 adds a marker. Record shows a passive global, provisional, or focused-only indicator and the reason for degraded scope.
features.requirement: Windows and macOS attempt registration automatically. GNOME Wayland attempts an owned binding on first launch. Global status requires observed callback proof; general Settings holds an advanced opt-out.

features.label: Raw capture mode
features.title: Raw MP4
features.description: Raw saves the unchanged original MP4 to the default export folder after Stop. Add to timeline or Save a copy are result actions; there is no destination picker before recording.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg and a writable default export folder. A Stop error requires exact capture-status classification before retry.

features.label: Auto-edit recording
features.title: Polished clip in Edit
features.description: Polished saves the same unchanged original MP4 and adds an editable clip to the open project; when no project is open, Cut creates a new recording project first. The editable clip receives zoom-to-cursor, cursor smoothing, and framing. Show keystrokes is optional, off by default, and shown directly beneath this mode. Export MP4 or GIF chooses a file after Stop.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg and a finalized capture. Camera composition requires an admitted camera artifact.

features.label: Studio event API
features.title: Studio event API
features.description: Agents and the UI append timed Studio events for background style, recording markers, and camera visibility or placement. Camera events replay against the finalized separate camera take when one exists.
features.requirement: Requires a valid project-bound capture_id returned by screen_record.start.

features.label: Import and organize media
features.title: Import and organize media
features.description: Import a file, verify it in Assets, then add it at the playhead or drag it into the base timeline. Muxed video enters as one aligned picture-and-sound placement.
features.requirement: Requires readable media and FFmpeg.

features.label: Build the base timeline, then overlays
features.title: Build the base timeline, then overlays
features.description: Drop ordinary clips onto the base timeline first. A muxed video validates its picture and sound destinations together. Use Alt-drag or drop on an overlay lane for B-roll, picture-in-picture, titles, masks, or any video that should composite above the main story.
features.requirement: Requires imported media; overlays need a video overlay lane and muxed video needs an audio destination.

features.label: Split and trim clips
features.title: Split and trim clips
features.description: Use Razor, Trim, Snap, Ripple delete, and Lift delete to shape the sequence.
features.requirement: Requires clips on the timeline.

features.label: Captions and transcript
features.title: Captions and transcript
features.description: Generate or import captions, style them, translate caption or transcript text, then use Inspector Find & Replace to preview exact track/range changes before one Undoable Replace.
features.requirement: Requires speech-to-text setup for generated transcript content; timing refresh is offered only with exact transcript-word evidence.

features.label: Edit for Clarity
features.title: Edit for Clarity
features.description: Preview and run the conservative clarity pass: transcribe, analyze pauses, remove retakes and fillers, then tighten pauses at the chosen intensity without forcing a delivery render.
features.requirement: Requires an open project with speech media and local speech-to-text readiness.

features.label: Prompt and storyboard Generate
features.title: Prompt and storyboard Generate
features.description: Use prompt and storyboard flows to create planned inserts, generated assets, and template-backed material.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent for planning flows.

features.label: Compare and place generated media
features.title: Compare and place generated media
features.description: Choose registered references, request a labelled variation, compare completed takes, select one, and insert or replace it from verified project history. Codex and Antigravity generate images; Grok Imagine also supports video. A cancelled placement can be retried explicitly.
features.requirement: Requires a configured generation provider and an open project; a provider call may spend quota only after the second confirmation click.

features.label: Edit a linked clip in Motion
features.title: Edit a linked clip in Motion
features.description: Select a Motion-linked clip, choose Edit in Motion, make rich source changes in ShellX Motion, render the copy-on-write revision, return to Cut, and refresh the same clip. Cut rechecks package identity, authored revision, receipt identity, and media hash before replacing the linked render.
features.requirement: Requires ShellX Motion and a current linked package. Refresh is explicit; stale or mismatched handbacks never replace the last good render.

features.label: Search across sequences
features.title: Search across sequences
features.description: Search clips and markers project-wide, narrow by kind, sequence, or track, and open a result to switch sequence and seek its time.
features.requirement: Requires an open project with one or more sequences.

features.label: Applied agent change
features.title: Applied agent change
features.description: Attach registered project assets or a timeline target, choose or edit a prompt, and run the turn. A validated result applies directly; inspect Preview and Diff, use Step back only while it is safe, or Ask replacement to re-resolve the retained target.
features.requirement: Requires a configured CLI agent and an open project. Concurrent later operations can make Step back unavailable.

features.label: Record, polish, export, and retry
features.title: Record, save, and export
features.description: Choose a real source, check readiness and native preview, select Raw MP4 or Polished clip in Edit, then Start. Both modes save the unchanged MP4 in the default export folder; Polished adds an editable project clip. If no project is open, Start or global F9 creates a new recording project automatically; an open project is used as-is. During capture, the preview uses frames from the exact capture owner. If Stop fails, Cut checks that capture status: Retry Stop is offered only while live, terminal is shown as ended, and uncertain ownership stays unknown. Export or Save a copy chooses optional destinations after Stop.
features.requirement: Requires desktop capture permission and FFmpeg; camera and system audio are optional. Global F9, live preview, output, and native badge behavior need installed-host verification.
features.api: project.create, screen_record.preview_start, screen_record.live_frame, screen_record.start, screen_record.status, screen_record.stop, screen_record.polish, screen_record.export, screen_record.copy_raw

features.label: Review receipts
features.title: Review receipts
features.description: Check operation history, receipts, QC, scopes, and diffs to understand the project state before rendering final output.
features.requirement: Requires project operations or completed checks.

features.label: Render and export
features.title: Render and export
features.description: Render a preview, final file, range, or delivery bundle from the active project. Render Queue destinations use one native Save dialog per output and show path-light filenames instead of editable absolute paths.
features.requirement: Requires FFmpeg and a valid output folder. Render Queue destination selection requires the desktop app.

features.label: Debug API overview
features.title: Debug API overview
features.description: Use the Debug API when you need repeatable automation, integration tests, external inspection, or MCP access to Cut.
features.requirement: Requires a running cutd server bound to loopback.

features.label: REST verbs
features.title: REST verbs
features.description: Dispatch Cut actions through the local REST endpoint when scripting, testing, or integrating with another tool.
features.requirement: Requires a running cutd server bound to loopback.

features.label: Project state
features.title: Project state
features.description: Read the current project, assets, tracks, clips, markers, and settings.
features.requirement: Requires an open project for timeline data.

features.label: WebSocket events
features.title: WebSocket events
features.description: Subscribe to operation, job, and UI-relevant state changes while Cut is running.
features.requirement: Requires a running cutd server.

features.label: MCP server
features.title: MCP server
features.description: Expose Cut verbs to MCP-capable clients through the cutd MCP command.
features.requirement: Requires cutd installed and a running Cut server for proxy mode.

features.label: Motion render status
features.title: Observe a Motion render
features.description: Choose a job_id before starting a blocking Motion-backed render, then query that same id from another request without exposing another project's jobs or Motion runtime paths.
features.requirement: Requires an open Cut project and a current ShellX Motion CLI. Poll no faster than pollAfterMs and stop when it disappears.

features.label: Verb catalog
features.title: Verb catalog
features.description: Read the machine-readable verb contract used by tools and docs.
features.requirement: Requires a running cutd server or local schema file.
